clearing.calibration: official level + 0.5 + difficultyDeltaScale * (10th-percentile skill - official-folder median 10th-percentile skill)
clearing.clearPopulation: unique nonbroken current-catalog clearers across both Phoenix versions
clearing.skillRating: current mode-specific clearingRating from official levels of the top 50 unique clears, requiring 50 clears
clearing.supportPopulation: all unique clearers with a finite clearing skill

pumbility.evidence: weaker component status; separate scoring and clearing support counts

clearing.capDefault: lowest uncapped nonempty chart estimate in the same official folder; midpoint if none
clearing.formula: official level + 0.5 + calibrated(0.70 * shrinkage weight * (20th-percentile clearer ability - folder median ability))
clearing.population: official clearers with at least 25 other distinct S22+/D23+ clears in the same mode

shrinkage.formula: eligible players / (eligible players + 20) * eligible players / observed unique players

uncertainty.conditions: fixed player histories, folder reference and scale; excludes selection and calibration uncertainty
uncertainty.method: 1000 deterministic player bootstrap samples of the 20th-percentile ability
